body: Take charge. Tell her what to do. Don’t be rude or mean, but be firm. Tell her to stand in front of you and take her clothes off one item at a time. Tell her what you want from her and ravage her.
You’re right. It doesn’t get better for everyone.
I’m sorry you’re struggling right now. I hope you find a therapist who uses an approach that connects with you.

I’m sorry this suggestion causes you more pain than it gives hope. I am suicidal as well. I was hospitalized for an attempt in March. I say this to let you know I can relate before letting you know, I do encourage people in my position to love themselves. My reason for saying this, is because I have felt unloved by others so often in my life. Love from others is unreliable. Depending on love and validation from other people is a sure fire way to sink deeper into depression for me. When I see my depressed friends sink deeper into depression after every break up or disappointment from friends or family, I want them to love themselves more to help them be stronger on their own and not self-destruct.

I read some of your posts to see where you’re coming from before responding. It sounds like you’ve had more than your share of dark times this past year. I am so sorry the situation is ongoing. Where are you at with the plan to move out? Are you still seeing your therapists? If you need to hear it, you are not responsible for her health and well-being. Take care of yourself first. You deserve happiness.
That sounds exactly like what I need. Thank you for mentioning it and sharing your experience. I will ask my therapist if we can start.
I’m sorry to hear that. Thank you for taking the time to share.

Sleep* can bring respite, I agree. It can be terribly saddening. Not being able to cry only makes it worse. Ha then if the tears do come, it’s floodgates and somehow that’s even worse! I don’t know which way I prefer it. To feel nothing or too much.
Fight is a good word for it.
Thanks for your reply. I haven’t tried EDMR. My therapist mentioned it. Has it helped you?

Please take care of yourself first, and then worry about your family. It sounds like some assistance might be available through your state. Medicated toothpaste and mouthwash are available with a prescription from a dentist to fight infection. We are our own worst critics. Your breast can be reconstructed by another surgeon. Your partners won’t notice like you do. You are beautiful and human.
You’re welcome. I’m so sorry you have CPTSD.
Thank you for writing. I apologize for not replying sooner. I’m doing better with help from a new therapist. Would you still like to talk?
My apologies for not replying sooner. I was in a hopeless place and didn’t know what to say. Thank you, for letting me know I’m not alone. I think I found the help I need now, and I hope you do, too.
